svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 372 long, square both ends; deburr the bore.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Water runs up the bore from the rotary union to the jacket.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bottom end: weld (TIG) a 1/2 in BSP stainless hex nipple into the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bore so its thread stands below the tube for the union.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Positions from the bottom end: driven pulley 16 to 56; lower

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bearing 71 to 111; brake collar 173 to 196; upper bearing 236

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: to 276; hub 341 to 368; top end flush with the jacket floor.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill a 6 mm cross hole for the hub pin 349 from the bottom end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: File a small flat for each bearing set screw.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: two flanged bearing units under the plates, set screws on

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the flats; spindle turns freely by hand before the bowl goes on.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: straight within 0.2 mm over its length (roll it on glass).
